observations: body L3: the Syriac word is printed in the Serto script, with a dot over the beth (qushshaya).
body L7: five spaced dots stand after «chorda», as printed.
body L34: the m of «usum» is printed broken, with a short stroke rising over it; it is not an accent.
body L36: a speck stands under the last h of «Ḥabash»; it is not a dot of the transliteration.
body L38: the formula (α) stands a little to the right of the middle of the line, as printed; the label is in the type of the text.
body L35, L38, L40: the minus signs of the formulas are printed as long dashes; they are set as minus signs.
